artifact: VigilAI Deep Medical Concept Normalization (MCN) surrogate pack

research_grounding.SapBERT: Self-alignment pretraining for biomedical entity vectors (cambridgeltl/SapBERT-from-PubMedBERT-fulltext) — used when local HF weights exist; otherwise deterministic char-ngram vectors
research_grounding.BERGAMOT: Multi-ontology mapping patterns for regulatory + EHR coding
research_grounding.FAISS: IndexFlatIP cosine k-NN over precomputed concept vectors
research_grounding.GeoNames: Municipal alias gazetteer for geographic synonym normalization
research_grounding.Mantra_GSC: Evaluation sample inspired by Mantra Gold Standard Corpus styles
research_grounding.CADEC: Colloquial ADE surfaces for MCN eval (not redistributed CADEC files)

disclaimer: Open teaching surrogates. Not licensed UMLS Metathesaurus, MedDRA, SNOMED-CT, or GeoNames bulk redistribution. Prototype — not for regulatory or clinical use.
